This is scientifically invalid; a fine-grained classifier identifies what an object IS, not what it is NOT, and cannot be used to validate that an object fails a specific biological taxonomy (e.g., 'has fur') simply because it is a different class. Furthermore, the plan fails to address the primary failure mode: the prompt requested 'two metal dogs', but only one is present.
